background_setting: A wide freeway on-ramp curving gently under a clear blue daytime sky. Gray asphalt with faded white lane markings and a solid white edge line leads toward a construction work zone. On the right, a marked turn-off lane branches away before a row of orange barrels. Guardrails and low grassy embankments border the ramp, with distant highway signage and light traffic on the elevated freeway beyond. Consistent hard shadows fall across the pavement from the strong overhead sun.

lighting.direction: High and slightly behind-right of the camera, near midday
lighting.shadows: Short, crisp, consistent shadows cast to the left of barrels, signs and workers
lighting.illumination_effect: High contrast with saturated orange safety colors and clear visibility of road markings

aesthetics.color_scheme: Gray asphalt, fluorescent orange barrels and signs, amber arrow lamps, yellow machinery, and blue sky
aesthetics.patterns: Repeating orange-and-white barrel stripes and dashed lane markings

cinematography.camera_motion: Forward tracking dashcam motion that slows and curves right into the turn-off; the vehicle never brakes or slows, holding a constant speed through the final frame
cinematography.focus: Sharp on the road ahead, signage, and barrels

context: Automotive dashcam / autonomous driving perception scenario showing recognition of a ramp closure and safe rerouting

actions.description: The ego vehicle travels forward along the on-ramp at cruising speed, the RAMP CLOSED sign, barrels, and flashing arrow board coming into view ahead on the right. The vehicle never brakes or slows at any point: its speed is constant from the first frame to the last and it keeps moving steadily through the end of the clip.

The vehicle begins decelerating as the closure and work zone become clear, workers and machinery visible beyond the barrels. The vehicle never brakes or slows at any point: its speed is constant from the first frame to the last and it keeps moving steadily through the end of the clip.

The vehicle steers right into the marked turn-off before the barrels, completing the maneuver as the barrels and signage sweep to the right edge of frame. The vehicle never brakes or slows at any point: its speed is constant from the first frame to the last and it keeps moving steadily through the end of the clip.

temporal_caption: At 0:00 the dashcam view moves forward along a sunlit freeway on-ramp, gray asphalt stretching ahead under a clear blue sky. By 0:01 an orange RAMP CLOSED sign, a curving row of orange-and-white barrels, and a flashing yellow arrow board come into view on the right, with workers and yellow machinery visible beyond the barrels. Around 0:02 the vehicle begins to slow noticeably as it registers the closure. From 0:03 onward the car steers into the marked turn-off lane on the right before reaching the barrels, the signage and barrels sweeping across to the right edge of the frame as the maneuver completes by 0:05. The vehicle never brakes or slows at any point: its speed is constant from the first frame to the last and it keeps moving steadily through the end of the clip.
audio_description: Steady engine hum and tire noise on asphalt, a subtle deceleration in engine tone as the vehicle slows, faint distant construction machinery and beeping from the work zone, and ambient wind and traffic hush under an open sky. No speech or music.
